endorsements.name: Victor Fidalgo Villar
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-40852
endorsements.description: TCMAN GIM is affected by an open redirect vulnerability. This vulnerability allows the redirection of user navigation to pages controlled by the attacker. The exploitation of this vulnerability might allow a remote attacker to obtain information.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)

endorsements.name: Victor Fidalgo Villar
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-40853
endorsements.description: TCMAN GIM does not perform an authorization check when trying to access determined resources. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to access URL that require privileges without having them. The exploitation of this vulnerability might allow a remote attacker to obtain sensible information.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.2)
